import math

bool one_of(string choices, string value)
    for word := choices.split(" ")[]
        if word == value
            return true
    return false

string lowercase(string text)
    result := ""
    for: position < #text
        character := text[position]
        match "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".find(character)
            nat index
                result += "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[index]
            none
                result += character
    return result

V | error required<K, V>(const map<K, V> values, K key)
    match values.get(key)
        V item
            return item
        none
            return error("missing internal value")

int[] ordered_positions(const int[] keys, descending := false)
    map<int, int[]> groups
    for position := keys.indices()[]
        int[] group := []
        match groups.get(keys[position])
            int[] existing
                group = existing
            none
                group = []
        .groups.set(keys[position], group.append(int(position)))
    int[] result := []
    for key := groups.keys().sorted(descending = descending)[]
        int[] group := required(groups, key)
        result = result.concat(group)
    return result

class Output(bool direct)
    string[] lines := []

void terminal(string text)
    println(text)

void emit(Output &output, string text)
    if output.direct
        terminal(text)
    else
        output.lines = output.lines.append(text)

class Options(string flags, string[] paths)
    bool has(string flag)
        return flags.contains(flag)

Options options(const string[] arguments)
    flags := ""
    nat position := 0
    while position < #arguments and arguments[position].starts_with("-")
        flags += arguments[position][1:]
        position += 1
    return Options(flags, arguments[position:])

string last_component(string path)
    parts := path.split("/")
    return parts[-1]

string joined(string path, string name)
    return if path == "/" then "/" + name else path + "/" + name

bool invalid_source(string path)
    name := last_component(path)
    return name == "" or name == "." or name == ".."

enum NodeData
    Directory(map<string, int>)
    File(string[])
    Link(string)

class Node(int parent, string name, int modified, NodeData data)
    string tag()
        match data
            NodeData.Directory
                return "d"
            NodeData.File
                return "f"
            NodeData.Link
                return "l"

    bool directory()
        return tag() == "d"

    map<string, int> entries()
        match data
            NodeData.Directory(items)
                return items
            NodeData.File
                return map<string, int>()
            NodeData.Link
                return map<string, int>()

    string[] lines()
        match data
            NodeData.Directory
                return []
            NodeData.File(items)
                return items
            NodeData.Link
                return []

    string target()
        match data
            NodeData.Directory
                return ""
            NodeData.File
                return ""
            NodeData.Link(path)
                return path

    int size()
        match data
            NodeData.Directory(items)
                return int(items.size())
            NodeData.File(items)
                return [for line := items[] then int(#line) + 1].sum()
            NodeData.Link(path)
                return int(#path)

class FileSystem()
    nodes := map<int, Node>()
    current := 1
    string | none previous := none
    clock := 0
    next_inode := 2
    int[] retired := []
    .nodes.set(1, Node(1, "", 0, NodeData.Directory(map<string, int>())))

Node get_node(const FileSystem source, int id)
    Node item := required(source.nodes, id)
    return item

int child(const FileSystem source, int parent, string name)
    match get_node(source, parent).entries().get(name)
        int id
            return id
        none
            return -1

class Entry(string name, int id)

Entry[] children(const FileSystem source, int id)
    entries := get_node(source, id).entries()
    Entry[] result := []
    for name := entries.keys().sorted()[]
        int node := required(entries, name)
        result = result.append(Entry(name, node))
    return result

int link_count(const FileSystem source, int id)
    node := get_node(source, id)
    if not node.directory()
        return 1
    directory_counts := [for entry := children(source, id)[] then (if get_node(source, entry.id).directory() then 1 else 0)]
    return 2 + directory_counts.sum()

string absolute(const FileSystem source, int id)
    string[] parts := []
    while id != 1
        node := get_node(source, id)
        parts = parts.append(node.name)
        id = node.parent
    return "/" + parts[::-1].join("/")

bool descendant(const FileSystem source, int id, int ancestor)
    while id != ancestor
        if id == 1
            return false
        id = get_node(source, id).parent
    return true

void attach(FileSystem &source, int parent, string name, int id)
    node := get_node(source, id)
    node.parent = parent
    node.name = name
    .source.nodes.set(id, node)
    directory := get_node(source, parent)
    entries := directory.entries()
    .entries.set(name, id)
    directory.data = NodeData.Directory(entries)
    directory.modified = source.clock
    .source.nodes.set(parent, directory)

int create_node(FileSystem &source, int parent, string name, NodeData data)
    id := source.next_inode
    source.next_inode += 1
    .source.nodes.set(id, Node(parent, name, source.clock, data))
    attach(&source, parent, name, id)
    return id

void detach(FileSystem &source, int id)
    node := get_node(source, id)
    directory := get_node(source, node.parent)
    entries := directory.entries()
    .entries.remove(node.name)
    directory.data = NodeData.Directory(entries)
    directory.modified = source.clock
    .source.nodes.set(node.parent, directory)

void remove_node(FileSystem &source, int id)
    detach(&source, id)
    source.retired = source.retired.append(id)

void reclaim(FileSystem &source)
    pending := source.retired
    nat position := 0
    while position < #pending
        id := pending[position]
        pending = pending.concat(get_node(source, id).entries().values())
        .source.nodes.remove(id)
        position += 1
    source.retired = []

void write_file(FileSystem &source, int id, const string[] lines, bool append)
    node := get_node(source, id)
    node.data = NodeData.File(if append then node.lines().concat(lines) else lines)
    node.modified = source.clock
    .source.nodes.set(id, node)

class Resolution(node := -1, parent := -1, name := "", problem := "")

Resolution walk(FileSystem &source, string path, int base, bool follow, bool original, bool parents, int &expansions)
    id := if path.starts_with("/") then 1 else base
    parts := [for part := path.split("/")[] if part != "" then part]
    for position := parts.indices()[]
        node := get_node(source, id)
        if not node.directory()
            return Resolution(problem = "Not a directory")
        name := parts[position]
        if name == "."
            continue
        if name == ".."
            id = node.parent
            continue
        last := position + 1 == #parts
        next := child(source, id, name)
        if next == -1
            if original and parents and not last
                next = create_node(&source, id, name, NodeData.Directory(map<string, int>()))
            else
                return Resolution(parent = if original and last then id else -1, name = name, problem = "No such file or directory")
        candidate := get_node(source, next)
        if candidate.tag() == "l" and (not last or follow)
            expansions += 1
            if expansions > 8
                return Resolution(problem = "Too many levels of symbolic links")
            target := walk(&source, candidate.target(), id, true, false, false, &expansions)
            if target.node == -1
                return target
            next = target.node
        id = next
    return Resolution(node = id)

Resolution resolve(FileSystem &source, string path, follow := true, parents := false)
    expansions := 0
    return walk(&source, path, source.current, follow, true, parents, &expansions)

class CloneStep(int source, int parent, string name)

void clone_tree(FileSystem &source, int original, int parent, string name)
    pending := [CloneStep(original, parent, name)]
    while #pending != 0
        step := pending[0]
        pending = pending[1:]
        node := get_node(source, step.source)
        NodeData data := if node.directory() then NodeData.Directory(map<string, int>()) else node.data
        copy := create_node(&source, step.parent, step.name, data)
        if node.directory()
            following := [for entry := children(source, step.source)[] then CloneStep(entry.id, copy, entry.name)]
            pending = following.concat(pending)

void move_one(FileSystem &source, string origin, string destination)
    if invalid_source(origin)
        terminal("mv: cannot move '{origin}' to '{destination}': Invalid argument")
        return
    found := resolve(&source, origin, false)
    if found.node == -1
        terminal("mv: cannot stat '{origin}': {found.problem}")
        return
    id := found.node
    resolved_destination := resolve(&source, destination)
    int parent
    string name
    string target
    if resolved_destination.node != -1 and get_node(source, resolved_destination.node).directory()
        parent = resolved_destination.node
        name = last_component(origin)
        target = joined(destination, name)
    else
        result := resolve(&source, destination, false)
        if result.node != -1
            node := get_node(source, result.node)
            parent = node.parent
            name = node.name
        elif result.parent != -1
            parent = result.parent
            name = result.name
        else
            terminal("mv: cannot move '{origin}' to '{destination}': {result.problem}")
            return
        target = destination
    existing := child(source, parent, name)
    directory := get_node(source, id).directory()
    existing_directory := existing != -1 and get_node(source, existing).directory()
    if directory and descendant(source, parent, id)
        terminal("mv: cannot move '{origin}' to a subdirectory of itself, '{target}'")
    elif existing == id
        terminal("mv: '{origin}' and '{target}' are the same file")
    elif existing != -1 and directory and not existing_directory
        terminal("mv: cannot overwrite non-directory '{target}' with directory '{origin}'")
    elif existing_directory and not directory
        terminal("mv: cannot overwrite directory '{target}' with non-directory '{origin}'")
    elif existing_directory and get_node(source, existing).size() != 0
        terminal("mv: cannot move '{origin}' to '{target}': Directory not empty")
    elif existing == source.current
        terminal("mv: cannot move '{origin}' to '{target}': Device or resource busy")
    else
        if existing != -1
            remove_node(&source, existing)
        detach(&source, id)
        attach(&source, parent, name, id)

void copy_one(FileSystem &source, string origin, string destination, bool recursive)
    if invalid_source(origin)
        terminal("cp: cannot copy '{origin}' to '{destination}': Invalid argument")
        return
    found := resolve(&source, origin)
    if found.node == -1
        terminal("cp: cannot stat '{origin}': {found.problem}")
        return
    id := found.node
    node := get_node(source, id)
    if node.directory() and not recursive
        terminal("cp: -r not specified; omitting directory '{origin}'")
        return
    result := resolve(&source, destination)
    if result.node == -1 and result.parent == -1
        terminal("cp: cannot copy '{origin}' to '{destination}': {result.problem}")
        return
    target := destination
    if result.node != -1 and get_node(source, result.node).directory()
        target = joined(destination, last_component(origin))
    result = resolve(&source, target, not node.directory())
    if node.directory()
        if result.node != -1
            terminal("cp: cannot copy '{origin}' to '{target}': File exists")
        elif descendant(source, result.parent, id)
            terminal("cp: cannot copy a directory, '{origin}', into itself, '{target}'")
        else
            clone_tree(&source, id, result.parent, result.name)
    elif result.parent != -1
        create_node(&source, result.parent, result.name, node.data)
    elif result.node == -1
        terminal("cp: cannot copy '{origin}' to '{target}': {result.problem}")
    elif result.node == id
        terminal("cp: '{origin}' and '{target}' are the same file")
    elif get_node(source, result.node).directory()
        terminal("cp: cannot overwrite directory '{target}' with non-directory '{origin}'")
    else
        write_file(&source, result.node, node.lines(), false)

void listing(FileSystem &source, const Options opts, Output &output)
    string[] paths := if #opts.paths == 0 then ["."] else opts.paths
    for path := paths[]
        result := resolve(&source, path, not opts.has("l"))
        if result.node == -1
            terminal("ls: cannot access '{path}': {result.problem}")
            continue
        node := get_node(source, result.node)
        Entry[] entries := []
        if not node.directory()
            entries = [Entry(path, result.node)]
        else
            if #paths > 1
                emit(&output, path + ":")
            if opts.has("a")
                entries = [Entry(".", result.node), Entry("..", node.parent)]
            entries = entries.concat([for entry := children(source, result.node)[] if opts.has("a") or not entry.name.starts_with(".") then entry])
            if opts.has("t")
                order := ordered_positions([for entry := entries[] then get_node(source, entry.id).modified], true)
                entries = [for position := order[] then entries[position]]
        if opts.has("r")
            entries = entries[::-1]
        if #entries == 0
            continue
        values := [for entry := entries[] then [link_count(source, entry.id), get_node(source, entry.id).size(), get_node(source, entry.id).modified]]
        widths := [for column := (nat(0):<3)[] then [for row := values[] then int(#string(row[column]))].max()]
        for position := entries.indices()[]
            entry := entries[position]
            if not opts.has("l")
                emit(&output, entry.name)
                continue
            item := get_node(source, entry.id)
            text := if item.tag() == "f" then "-" else item.tag()
            for: nat column < 3
                number := string(values[position][column])
                text += " " + " " * nat(widths[column] - int(#number)) + number
            text += " " + entry.name
            if item.tag() == "l"
                text += " -> " + item.target()
            emit(&output, text)

class Visit(int id, string display, string name, int depth)

Visit[] visits(const FileSystem source, int id, string path, limit := 1000)
    name := if path == "/" then "/" else last_component(path)
    pending := [Visit(id, path, name, 0)]
    Visit[] result := []
    while #pending != 0
        visit := pending[0]
        pending = pending[1:]
        result = result.append(visit)
        if get_node(source, visit.id).directory() and visit.depth < limit
            following := [for entry := children(source, visit.id)[] then Visit(entry.id, joined(visit.display, entry.name), entry.name, visit.depth + 1)]
            pending = following.concat(pending)
    return result

bool glob_matches(string pattern, string text)
    previous := array(#text + 1, fill = false)
    previous[0] = true
    for: position < #pattern
        character := pattern[position]
        following := array(#previous, fill = false)
        following[0] = character == "*" and previous[0]
        for: index < #text
            following[index + 1] = if character == "*" then previous[index + 1] or following[index] else previous[index] and (character == "?" or character == text[index])
        previous = following
    return previous[#text]

void find_nodes(FileSystem &source, const string[] arguments, Output &output)
    path := "."
    nat position := 0
    if #arguments > 0 and not arguments[0].starts_with("-")
        path = arguments[0]
        position = 1
    pattern := ""
    kind := ""
    limit := 1000
    while position < #arguments
        predicate := arguments[position]
        value := arguments[position + 1]
        if predicate == "-name"
            pattern = value
        elif predicate == "-type"
            kind = value
        else
            limit = int(value)
        position += 2
    result := resolve(&source, path)
    if result.node == -1
        terminal("find: '{path}': {result.problem}")
        return
    for visit := visits(source, result.node, path, limit)[]
        if (pattern == "" or glob_matches(pattern, visit.name)) and (kind == "" or get_node(source, visit.id).tag() == kind)
            emit(&output, visit.display)

int report_usage(const FileSystem source, int id, string path, bool show, const Options opts, Output &output)
    node := get_node(source, id)
    amount := node.size()
    if node.directory()
        amount = [for entry := children(source, id)[] then report_usage(source, entry.id, joined(path, entry.name), show and not opts.has("s") and (get_node(source, entry.id).directory() or opts.has("a")), opts, &output)].sum()
    if show
        emit(&output, "{amount} {path}")
    return amount

void disk_usage(FileSystem &source, const Options opts, Output &output)
    string[] paths := if #opts.paths == 0 then ["."] else opts.paths
    for path := paths[]
        result := resolve(&source, path)
        if result.node == -1
            terminal("du: cannot access '{path}': {result.problem}")
        else
            report_usage(source, result.node, path, true, opts, &output)

int[] draw(const FileSystem source, int id, string prefix, bool all, Output &output)
    entries := [for entry := children(source, id)[] if all or not entry.name.starts_with(".") then entry]
    counts := [0, 0]
    for position := entries.indices()[]
        entry := entries[position]
        node := get_node(source, entry.id)
        last := position + 1 == #entries
        text := prefix + (if last then "`-- " else "|-- ") + entry.name
        if node.tag() == "l"
            text += " -> " + node.target()
        emit(&output, text)
        if node.directory()
            counts += [1, 0] + draw(source, entry.id, prefix + (if last then "    " else "|   "), all, &output)
        else
            counts[1] += 1
    return counts

void tree(FileSystem &source, const Options opts, Output &output)
    path := if #opts.paths == 0 then "." else opts.paths[0]
    result := resolve(&source, path)
    if result.node == -1
        terminal("tree: {path}: {result.problem}")
        return
    if not get_node(source, result.node).directory()
        terminal("tree: {path}: Not a directory")
        return
    emit(&output, path)
    counts := draw(source, result.node, "", opts.has("a"), &output)
    directories := if counts[0] == 1 then "directory" else "directories"
    files := if counts[1] == 1 then "file" else "files"
    emit(&output, "{counts[0]} {directories}, {counts[1]} {files}")

int word_count(string line)
    return int(#[for word := line.split(" ")[] if word != "" then word])

class TextState(string command, Options opts, pattern := "", named := false, count := 10, special := false)
    totals := [0, 0, 0]
    string[] gathered := []

void report_counts(const int[] counts, string | none name, const Options opts, Output &output)
    all := not opts.has("l") and not opts.has("w") and not opts.has("c")
    text := [for position := (nat(0):<3)[] if all or opts.has("lwc"[position]) then string(counts[position])].join(" ")
    match name
        string label
            text += " " + label
        none
            text += ""
    emit(&output, text)

void consume(TextState &state, const string[] lines, string | none name, Output &output)
    if state.command == "cat"
        for line := lines[]
            emit(&output, line)
    elif state.command == "sort"
        state.gathered = state.gathered.concat(lines)
    elif state.command == "wc"
        counts := [int(#lines), [for line := lines[] then word_count(line)].sum(), [for line := lines[] then int(#line) + 1].sum()]
        state.totals += counts
        report_counts(counts, name, state.opts, &output)
    elif state.command == "head" or state.command == "tail"
        start := 0
        stop := int(#lines)
        if state.command == "head"
            stop = if state.special then math.max(0, stop - state.count) else math.min(stop, state.count)
        else
            start = if state.special then math.min(stop, math.max(0, state.count - 1)) else math.max(0, stop - state.count)
        for line := lines[start:<stop][]
            emit(&output, line)
    elif state.command == "grep"
        prefix := ""
        if state.named
            match name
                string label
                    prefix = label + ":"
                none
                    prefix = ""
        selected := 0
        for position := lines.indices()[]
            line := lines[position]
            value := if state.opts.has("i") then lowercase(line) else line
            if value.contains(state.pattern) == state.opts.has("v")
                continue
            selected += 1
            if not state.opts.has("c")
                text := prefix
                if state.opts.has("n")
                    text += string(position + 1) + ":"
                emit(&output, text + line)
        if state.opts.has("c")
            emit(&output, prefix + string(selected))
    else
        nat start := 0
        while start < #lines
            end := start + 1
            while end < #lines and lines[end] == lines[start]
                end += 1
            text := lines[start]
            if state.opts.has("c")
                text = string(end - start) + " " + text
            emit(&output, text)
            start = end

int numeric_prefix(string text)
    negative := text.starts_with("-")
    start := if negative then 1 else 0
    end := start
    while end < int(#text) and "0123456789".contains(text[end])
        end += 1
    if end == start
        return 0
    value := int(text[start:<end])
    return if negative then -value else value

void text_command(FileSystem &source, string command, const string[] arguments, const string[] input, Output &output)
    opts := options(arguments)
    state := TextState(command, opts)
    paths := opts.paths
    recursive := false
    if command == "head" or command == "tail"
        paths = arguments
        if #arguments > 0 and arguments[0] == "-n"
            count := arguments[1]
            state.special = count.starts_with("-") or count.starts_with("+")
            state.count = int(if state.special then count[1:] else count)
            paths = arguments[2:]
    elif command == "grep"
        state.pattern = paths[0]
        paths = paths[1:]
        if opts.has("i")
            state.pattern = lowercase(state.pattern)
        recursive = opts.has("r")
        state.named = recursive or #paths > 1
        if recursive and #paths == 0
            paths = ["."]
    if #paths == 0
        consume(&state, input, none, &output)
    else
        for path := paths[]
            result := resolve(&source, path)
            if result.node == -1
                terminal("{command}: {path}: {result.problem}")
                continue
            node := get_node(source, result.node)
            if recursive
                for visit := visits(source, result.node, path)[]
                    item := get_node(source, visit.id)
                    if item.tag() == "f"
                        consume(&state, item.lines(), visit.display, &output)
            elif node.directory()
                terminal("{command}: {path}: Is a directory")
            else
                consume(&state, node.lines(), path, &output)
    if command == "wc" and #paths > 1
        report_counts(state.totals, "total", opts, &output)
    if command == "sort"
        sorted := state.gathered.sorted()
        if opts.has("n")
            order := ordered_positions([for line := sorted[] then numeric_prefix(line)])
            sorted = [for position := order[] then sorted[position]]
        if opts.has("r")
            sorted = sorted[::-1]
        for line := sorted[]
            emit(&output, line)

void execute(FileSystem &source, string text, const string[] input, Output &output)
    words := text.split(" ")
    command := words[0]
    arguments := words[1:]
    opts := options(arguments)
    if command == "pwd"
        emit(&output, absolute(source, source.current))
    elif command == "echo"
        emit(&output, text[5:])
    elif command == "cd"
        path := if #arguments == 0 then "/" else arguments[0]
        previous := path == "-"
        if previous
            match source.previous
                string saved
                    path = saved
                none
                    terminal("cd: OLDPWD not set")
                    return
        result := resolve(&source, path)
        if result.node == -1
            terminal("cd: {path}: {result.problem}")
        elif not get_node(source, result.node).directory()
            terminal("cd: {path}: Not a directory")
        else
            source.previous = absolute(source, source.current)
            source.current = result.node
            if previous
                emit(&output, absolute(source, source.current))
    elif command == "mkdir"
        for path := opts.paths[]
            result := resolve(&source, path, false, opts.has("p"))
            if result.parent != -1
                create_node(&source, result.parent, result.name, NodeData.Directory(map<string, int>()))
            elif result.node == -1
                terminal("mkdir: cannot create directory '{path}': {result.problem}")
            else
                existing_directory := false
                if opts.has("p")
                    followed := resolve(&source, path)
                    existing_directory = followed.node != -1 and get_node(source, followed.node).directory()
                if not existing_directory
                    terminal("mkdir: cannot create directory '{path}': File exists")
    elif command == "touch"
        for path := arguments[]
            result := resolve(&source, path)
            if result.parent != -1
                create_node(&source, result.parent, result.name, NodeData.File([]))
            elif result.node == -1
                terminal("touch: cannot touch '{path}': {result.problem}")
            else
                node := get_node(source, result.node)
                node.modified = source.clock
                .source.nodes.set(result.node, node)
    elif command == "ls"
        listing(&source, opts, &output)
    elif command == "stat"
        for path := arguments[]
            result := resolve(&source, path, false)
            if result.node == -1
                terminal("stat: cannot stat '{path}': {result.problem}")
                continue
            node := get_node(source, result.node)
            string kind
            match node.data
                NodeData.Directory
                    kind = "directory"
                NodeData.File(lines)
                    kind = if #lines == 0 then "regular empty file" else "regular file"
                NodeData.Link
                    kind = "symbolic link"
            emit(&output, "{path}: {kind}, size {node.size()}, inode {result.node}, links {link_count(source, result.node)}, modified {node.modified}")
    elif command == "rm" or command == "rmdir"
        for path := opts.paths[]
            directory_only := command == "rmdir"
            name := last_component(path)
            dot := name == "." or name == ".."
            if dot and not directory_only
                terminal("rm: refusing to remove '.' or '..' directory: skipping '{path}'")
                continue
            problem := ""
            if dot
                problem = "Invalid argument"
            else
                result := resolve(&source, path, false)
                if result.node == -1
                    if not directory_only and opts.has("f") and result.problem == "No such file or directory"
                        continue
                    problem = result.problem
                else
                    node := get_node(source, result.node)
                    if directory_only and not node.directory()
                        problem = "Not a directory"
                    elif not directory_only and node.directory() and not opts.has("r")
                        problem = "Is a directory"
                    elif descendant(source, source.current, result.node)
                        problem = "Device or resource busy"
                    elif directory_only and node.size() != 0
                        problem = "Directory not empty"
                    else
                        remove_node(&source, result.node)
            if problem != ""
                if directory_only
                    terminal("rmdir: failed to remove '{path}': {problem}")
                else
                    terminal("rm: cannot remove '{path}': {problem}")
    elif command == "mv" or command == "cp"
        destination := opts.paths[-1]
        if #opts.paths > 2
            result := resolve(&source, destination)
            if result.node == -1 or not get_node(source, result.node).directory()
                terminal("{command}: target '{destination}' is not a directory")
                return
        for: position < #opts.paths - 1
            if command == "mv"
                move_one(&source, opts.paths[position], destination)
            else
                copy_one(&source, opts.paths[position], destination, opts.has("r"))
    elif command == "ln"
        path := arguments[2]
        result := resolve(&source, path, false)
        if result.parent != -1
            create_node(&source, result.parent, result.name, NodeData.Link(arguments[1]))
        else
            problem := if result.node != -1 then "File exists" else result.problem
            terminal("ln: failed to create symbolic link '{path}': {problem}")
    elif command == "readlink" or command == "realpath"
        path := arguments[0]
        result := resolve(&source, path, command == "realpath")
        if result.node == -1
            terminal("{command}: {path}: {result.problem}")
        elif command == "realpath"
            emit(&output, absolute(source, result.node))
        elif get_node(source, result.node).tag() == "l"
            emit(&output, get_node(source, result.node).target())
        else
            terminal("readlink: {path}: Invalid argument")
    elif command == "find"
        find_nodes(&source, arguments, &output)
    elif command == "du"
        disk_usage(&source, opts, &output)
    elif command == "tree"
        tree(&source, opts, &output)
    elif one_of("cat wc head tail grep sort uniq", command)
        text_command(&source, command, arguments, input, &output)
    else
        terminal("{command}: command not found")

void process_line(FileSystem &source, string line)
    source.clock += 1
    terminal(absolute(source, source.current) + "$ " + line)
    marker := -1
    append := false
    match line.find(" >> ")
        nat position
            marker = int(position)
            append = true
        none
            match line.find(" > ")
                nat position
                    marker = int(position)
                none
                    marker = -1
    pipeline := line
    redirect := -1
    if marker != -1
        pipeline = line[0:<marker]
        path := line[marker + (if append then 4 else 3):]
        result := resolve(&source, path)
        if result.parent != -1
            redirect = create_node(&source, result.parent, result.name, NodeData.File([]))
        elif result.node == -1
            terminal("sh: {path}: {result.problem}")
            return
        elif get_node(source, result.node).directory()
            terminal("sh: {path}: Is a directory")
            return
        else
            redirect = result.node
            if not append
                write_file(&source, redirect, [], false)
    commands := pipeline.split(" | ")
    string[] input := []
    for position := commands.indices()[]
        output := Output(position + 1 == #commands and redirect == -1)
        execute(&source, commands[position], input, &output)
        input = output.lines
    if redirect != -1 and #input > 0
        write_file(&source, redirect, input, true)
    reclaim(&source)

filesystem := FileSystem()
while true
    string line
    scan(&line)
    if line == "exit"
        break
    process_line(&filesystem, line)
